description.narrative: (former Inclusion Financiere Numerique) - This Project Initiation Plan (PIP) intends to facilitate programmatic continuity of the Policy Accelerator and act as a bridge between Phase I (2018-2024) and Phase II (2025-2028). The PIP describes the inception phase of UNCDF’s engagement with policymakers and regulators in 18 LDC and LMICs. It summarizes UNCDF priorities and contributions enabling the investment climate through public policy reform for inclusive digital economies, Sustainable Development Goals, and the national development objectives of the respective LDC/LMIC governments. The objective of this inception phase is the finalisation of the Policy Accelerator programme document (currently under review) whose activities will coincide with the initial programme activities conducted as part of the inception phase of the program.
